resources.string: Display your selected photos and videos from Google Photos on this TV.

Ambient Gallery connects directly to Google Photos using the Google Photos Ambient API.

• Only media from albums/sources you select in Google Photos will appear on this screen.
• Your photos and videos are streamed for ambient display and never copied into an external cloud storage.
• You can reconfigure or disconnect Google Photos anytime from Settings.
Give your device a recognizable name so you can easily identify it when selecting media sources in Google Photos.
Use your mobile device to complete album selection in Google Photos.

Are you sure you want to disconnect Google Photos from this TV?

• The ambient device association will be removed from your Google account.
• Selected photos and videos will no longer appear on this TV.
• You can reconnect anytime by scanning a new setup QR code.
